hero.label: Phase 1
hero.vraag: Do I recognise myself in this?
hero.intro:
We are entering your journey. Not a journey to learn, but to unlearn. To see and to feel who you are, and to recognise the patterns you have been shown, so you can come back in line with who you really are.

In six short steps you will meet your story, your birth chart, your planets, your moon phase, your numbers and your Tikkun. Open one, close it, come back tomorrow. Nothing here expires.
hero.kader: This is where you begin. Not the blueprint yet, but the way in. Six short steps, and you may stop after any of them.

stappen.kaart: What you recognise before anything is explained.

blokken.tekst: You learned to be strong. Early on you noticed that a lot was expected of you. You took responsibility, kept things under control and learned to carry on, also when what you actually needed was rest.

You may recognise that you first look at what other people need. That you adjust easily, and only notice later what you wanted yourself. And that when something does not work, you ask sooner what you could have done differently than what was really being asked of you.
These are not mistakes. They are the ways you learned to move through life. Nothing below is new. It is only being said out loud.
“Read it slowly. You are only checking whether it is true.”

blokken.kop: Being the strong one became normal
blokken.tekst: Somewhere early on, being the strong one stopped being a choice and became simply how things were. You do not remember deciding it. You remember it being true, and everyone around you getting used to it. The awkward part is that it works. You are good at it. Which is exactly why nobody ever asks whether it is heavy.

blokken.kop: You feel the room before anyone speaks
blokken.tekst: You walk in and you know. Who is off, who is performing, what is not being said. It is not something you trained, it is closer to hearing. And because you notice it, you begin adjusting before you have even thought about it. By the end of the evening you have carried something nobody handed you.

blokken.kop: You know when something is finished
blokken.tekst: Long before it is said out loud, you feel the ending arrive. A friendship, a job, a house, a version of yourself. Other people are still making plans while you have quietly started saying goodbye on the inside. That is why endings rarely surprise you, and why you sometimes leave a room before anyone notices you have gone.

blokken.kop: You start slowly and you outlast everyone
blokken.tekst: You take a long time to begin. You turn it over, you wait, you let it sit. People who move fast get ahead of you at the start. Then you begin, and you do not stop, and one by one they fall away. What looked like hesitation was you making sure it would hold.

blokken.kop: Freedom and responsibility both pull at you
blokken.tekst: Something in you needs room. Open doors, no fixed answer yet, the possibility of leaving. And something else in you keeps saying yes to one more thing that needs carrying. Both are real. The pull between them is not indecision. It is two true parts of you asking for the same day.

blokken.kop: Being seen still costs you something
blokken.tekst: You can do the work. You can hold the room. What is harder is standing in front of it with your own name on it. Right before you step forward there is a small hesitation nobody else can see. And afterwards, when it lands, you move on quickly rather than staying in it.

blokken.kop: You would rather do it than explain it
blokken.tekst: Asking takes longer than doing. You have proof: you asked once, it came back half right, and you fixed it yourself anyway. So the habit set. The cost does not show up that day. It shows up on the evening you are done and there is nobody who knows what it took.

items: I sense quickly what other people need.
I take responsibility, also when it is not mine.
I hear what is not being said.
I find it hard to really come to a stop.
I often know what has to be done, not always what I want.
I finish things long after other people have moved on.
I am loyal, also when it costs me something.
For a long time I thought I was only worth something when I performed.

blokken.tekst: None of this is a verdict. It is a description. Some of it will be true today and different next month, and that is how it should be. Take what lands. Leave the rest.

“I do not have to become stronger.
I may remember that I already am.”

stappen.kaart: Your own chart, as an image.
stappen.sub: The sky at the hour you arrived.

blokken.tekst: Your birth chart is a map of the sky at the moment you were born. It shows where the planets stood, and together they form your own pattern.

Each planet, sign and house stands for a theme in your life, from your strengths and talents to the lessons you are here to meet. The chart below is an example, so you can see how one is built. Yours comes in the next steps.

blokken.onder: An example chart. Yours follows in the next steps.

blokken.tekst:
“As above, so within you.
The same universe lives in you.”

items.kort: The different parts of your personality.
items.tekst: Every planet stands for one way of being. The sun is what drives you, the moon is what you feel, mercury is how you think and speak, venus is how you love, mars is how you act. They are not forces acting on you from outside. They are names for parts you already recognise in yourself.

items.kort: Your emotional nature and inner rhythm.
items.tekst: The moon travels through a cycle of about twenty nine days, from dark to full and back. The phase she stood in at your birth says something about your rhythm: whether you begin on instinct, build slowly, or sense when something is finished before anyone says so.

items.kort: Where the energy lands in your life.
items.tekst: The chart is divided into twelve areas of life: work, love, home, money, friendship, growth. A planet in a house tells you where that energy shows up in practice. Same planet, different house, a completely different daily life.

stappen.kaart: Twelve cards. What each one does and how you recognise it.

blokken.tekst: Each planet stands for a part of you: an energy, a theme, a lesson. Together they form a pattern that shapes how you think, feel, act and grow.

items.sub: what you are here to meet

blokken.tekst:
“As above, so within you.
The same forces move in you.”
Tap a planet. Each one is a part of you that you will probably recognise.

items.kort: What lights you up.
items.algemeen: The Sun is your engine. It is the thing you cannot switch off, the reason you get out of bed, the part of you people meet first and remember longest.
items.jouw: Your Sun is in Scorpio, in house 4.
items.jouwtekst: Your Sun sits in Scorpio, in the part of the chart that holds home and family. Which means you were never built for small talk. You want the real version, and you can smell the polished one from across the room. People think that is intensity. To you it is just honest.
herkenning: You ask the question the room was avoiding.
You cannot pretend to be fine when you are not.
You need a door that closes.
People tell you things they have told nobody.
You are all in, or you walk away.
items.herinnering:
You are not too intense.
You are simply not interested in fake.

items.kort: What you need to feel safe.
items.sub: What you need to feel safe.
items.algemeen: The Moon is your inner weather. It is what you needed as a child and still need now, and it does not care whether it is convenient.
items.jouw: Your Moon is in Scorpio, in house 4.
items.jouwtekst: Your Moon is in Scorpio, in the house of home. You feel everything at full volume, and then you go and sort it out alone. Time where nobody wants anything from you is not a treat. It is maintenance.
herkenning: You know the mood in a room before anyone speaks.
You go quiet first, then you talk.
You need real rest, not scrolling.
You remember what people said long after they forgot.
You trust slowly, and then completely.
items.herinnering:
Needing time alone
is not shutting people out.

items.kort: How your mind works.
items.algemeen: Mercury is your thinking and your talking. How fast, how deep, how much you say and how much you keep.
items.jouw: Your Mercury is in Scorpio, in house 4.
items.jouwtekst: Your Mercury is in Scorpio too. You do not skim. You dig, and you notice the thing that does not add up. And you would rather say nothing at all than say half of what you mean.
herkenning: You spot the inconsistency and nobody knows how.
Small talk exhausts you more than you admit.
You stay quiet until you are sure.
When you finally say it, it lands.
You read people faster than you read books.
items.herinnering:
Your silence is not distance.
It is you making sure it is true.

items.kort: How you love and what you enjoy.
items.sub: How you love and what you enjoy.
items.algemeen: Venus is pleasure, love and taste. What makes you happy, who you fall for, and what you think is worth your time.
items.jouw: Your Venus is in Sagittarius, in house 5.
items.jouwtekst: Your Venus is in Sagittarius, in the house of play. You would rather hear the truth than a kind lie, and you need room to move inside love. Cage it and something in you leaves before your body does.
herkenning: You give a lot, often before anyone asks.
You need space inside a relationship, not less love.
You lose interest the moment it gets small.
You say the honest thing at the dinner table.
Beauty and meaning beat status every time.
items.herinnering:
Wanting room is not distance.
It is how you stay honest.

items.kort: How you get things done.
items.algemeen: Mars is your engine room. How you start, how you push, and what happens when someone gets in your way.
items.jouw: Your Mars is in Taurus, retrograde, in house 10.
items.jouwtekst: Your Mars is in Taurus and it is retrograde, sitting in the house of work. You take forever to start, and then you cannot be stopped. Your anger goes inward first, which is why it arrives late and very clear.
herkenning: You think it over long before you begin.
Once you start, you finish.
You outlast people who set off much faster.
Your anger shows up a day late.
You build things meant to hold.
items.herinnering:
You do not have to move faster
to move forward.

items.kort: Where life opens up for you.
items.sub: Where life opens up for you.
items.algemeen: Jupiter is your luck and your appetite. Where you say yes, where you grow, and where you sometimes take on more than fits.
items.jouw: Your Jupiter is in Aquarius, in house 6.
items.jouwtekst: Your Jupiter is in Aquarius, in the house of daily work. You grow when you are allowed to do it your own way, and you see the structure behind the mess long before anyone else does.
herkenning: You get restless inside other people's rules.
Your best ideas are practical, not lofty.
You fix the process, not just the problem.
You grow fastest with room to experiment.
You build for people, not for show.
items.herinnering:
Your way is not the detour.
It is the road.

items.kort: Where it is hard, and where you get strong.
items.sub: Where it is hard, and where you get strong.
items.algemeen: Saturn is the teacher nobody asked for. It shows you where life keeps handing you the same lesson until you finally learn it, and then it hands you mastery.
items.jouw: Your Saturn is in Cancer, retrograde, in house 11.
items.jouwtekst: Your Saturn is in Cancer, in the house of groups. Your lesson is receiving. You are the one who carries, organises and holds, and you got so good at it that nobody notices it is heavy.
herkenning: You would rather do it yourself than ask.
You are the one people lean on.
You notice when you are the only one giving.
You feel responsible for the mood of the group.
Asking for help still feels like a risk.
items.herinnering:
Letting someone help you
is not weakness. It is the other half.

items.kort: Where you refuse to do it their way.
items.sub: Where you refuse to do it their way.
items.algemeen: Uranus is the part of you that breaks the pattern. It is sudden, it is honest, and it does not ask permission.
items.jouw: Your Uranus is in Libra, in house 4.
items.jouwtekst: Your Uranus is in Libra, in the house of home and family. You broke with something your family took for granted, and you cannot sit still inside an agreement that is only fair on paper.
herkenning: You left a pattern your family kept.
You cannot pretend for long.
You need relationships that leave you free.
You change course the moment something stops being true.
You are the odd one, and it suits you.
items.herinnering:
You are not difficult.
You are unwilling to pretend.

items.kort: Where you dream and where you drift.
items.sub: Where you dream and where you drift.
items.algemeen: Neptune is imagination, longing and the soft edge of things. It is beautiful, and it is also where you give people the benefit of the doubt one time too many.
items.jouw: Your Neptune is in Sagittarius, in house 5.
items.jouwtekst: Your Neptune is in Sagittarius, in the house of creating. You see the finished thing before it exists, and sometimes your plan is one size larger than the day has room for.
herkenning: You see it finished before you have started.
Stories move you more than arguments.
You give second chances easily.
If you do not make something, it builds up.
You feel what is not being said.
items.herinnering:
Dreaming big is not naive.
It is how you find the direction.

items.kort: Where you go all the way down.
items.sub: Where you go all the way down.
items.algemeen: Pluto is what ends so something else can begin. It is power, truth and the compost heap of your life.
items.jouw: Your Pluto is in Libra, in house 3.
items.jouwtekst: Your Pluto is in Libra, in the house of talking and writing. For you it runs through words. One sentence from you can tip a whole situation, which is a lot of power to carry lightly.
herkenning: Your words weigh more than you think.
You have rebuilt your life at least once.
You see the power play in a room.
You cannot unsee what you have seen.
You would rather break it than fake it.
items.herinnering:
You are not too much.
You are simply not shallow.

items.kort: The sore spot that became your gift.
items.sub: The sore spot that became your gift.
items.algemeen: Chiron is the old bruise. Press it and it still hurts, and it is exactly the place where you can help someone else better than anyone.
items.jouw: Your Chiron is in Aries, on your Midheaven.
items.jouwtekst: Your Chiron sits right on the top of your chart, the most visible point there is. Going first, being seen, taking the lead: that is where it stings, and that is also your work.
herkenning: Being seen still costs you something.
You help others do what was once hard for you.
You doubt yourself right before you step forward.
You made a way where there was none.
People find you through your scar, not your polish.
items.herinnering:
The place that hurt
is the place you can hold for someone else.

items.kort: Where you are heading.
items.algemeen: The North Node is the direction that never feels natural, and always feels alive once you go there anyway.
items.jouw: Your North Node is in Capricorn, in house 5.
items.jouwtekst: Yours is in Capricorn, in the house of play and creation. Give it form, stay with it, put your name on it. And, since it lives in the house of joy, enjoy it while you build.
herkenning: Putting your name on it feels risky.
You are happiest building something of your own.
You have to choose yourself on purpose.
Finishing matters more than starting.
The joy is part of the work, not the prize.
items.herinnering:
Standing in your own name
is not arrogance. It is your direction.

stappen.kaart: The phase of the moon, drawn from your own chart.

blokken.tekst: The Moon is your inner world: your feelings, your instinct and the way you connect. The phase she was in when you were born says something about the rhythm you arrived with.

blokken.kop: You were born under a balsamic moon.
blokken.tekst: Two degrees before the new moon, in the last hour of a cycle, with the moon dark in the sky. Balsamic people feel when something is finished before anyone says it out loud. You let go early, you take your leave quietly, and you often already live in the chapter the others have not opened yet.

lijst.kop: You may recognise this in yourself
items: You know it is over before anything is said.
You take your leave without announcing it.
You need more rest than the people around you.
You feel old things that are not yours.
You are already busy with what comes next.

herinnering.tekst:
Letting go early is not giving up.
It is how you make room.

stappen.kaart: Your vibration. The numbers you were born with.

blokken.tekst: Your name and your birth date carry numbers. Not as a trick, but as a rhythm: what you came here to do, what you long for, and where you are in the cycle right now.
Everything moves. Everything vibrates. The secret of your creation is your vibration.

1 starts things that were not there before. 22 builds something other people can stand on. 11 feels it before it can be explained. And 9 is the year you are in now: clearing out, so the 1 can begin in 2027.

blokken.kop: Life path 1, with a 22 in your name.
blokken.tekst: You are the one who goes first, and you are not always thrilled about it. The 22 asks you to build something that outlives the moment, and the 11 underneath means you sense the direction long before you can defend it. That gap between knowing and explaining is not a flaw. It is your timing.

blokken.kop: Your growth numbers · this used to be called karma

items.kort: A theme that keeps coming back. You have none.
items.tekst: A returning number appears when one of your core numbers lands on 13, 14, 16 or 19 just before its final step. It points at something that keeps knocking until you do it. Your birth date carries none of them, which is rare. No old bill to pay. What you do have is a path that asks you to go first, and that is work enough.

items.kort: The 5. Freedom, movement, change.
items.tekst: Every letter of your name carries a number, and one of them shows up more than the rest. That one hums underneath everything, whether you steer by it or not. Yours is the 5: freedom, movement, change. Which means the question is never whether you are allowed to be free. It is why you keep tying yourself down.

items.kort: A number missing from your name. Yours has none.
items.tekst: When a number never appears in your name, it is not a debt. It is a muscle nobody handed you, and you get to train it yourself. This used to be called a karmic lesson. On your working name not a single number is missing, which almost never happens. For the final answer we need your name as it stands on your birth certificate, because that is the name the letters are counted from.

stappen.kaart: Your soul correction. The place where the work is.

blokken.tekst: Tikkun is an old word for repair. Not repairing what is broken in you, but the one pattern you keep meeting until you turn and face it. Everybody has one. It usually looks like the thing you are very good at.

You learned early that asking makes you vulnerable, so you took the weight instead. You got so good at it that nobody sees it is heavy. The repair is not to care less. It is to let someone hold something of yours, and to put your own name on what you build.

lijst.kop: You may recognise this in yourself
items: You would rather do it yourself than explain it twice.
You are the one everyone leans on.
You notice when you are the only one giving.
Saying yes is easy, asking is not.
You are proud of what you made, and you rarely say so out loud.

herinnering.tekst:
You do not have to earn your place
by carrying everyone.

hero.label: Phase 2
hero.intro:
You are looking deeper now. You see the connections, the origin and the meaning. What you recognised earlier is given context. That is what makes room, understanding and choice.

In this phase you move from insight into awareness. You discover how old patterns, beliefs and your self-image are tied to one another.
hero.kader: The second of the three. You have met the pieces, here they start to connect, so the blueprint becomes readable.

helderheid.afsluiting:
You do not have to know it yet. All of it is allowed to be here. Confusion is often the phase in which something new can begin.
You have already taken a real step. You are looking not only at what happened, but also at why.

stappen.kaart: The situations that keep returning in your life. What do you keep seeing?
stappen.quote:
A deeper understanding
A brighter you
stappen.midden: It is not separate parts. It is one pattern.

blokken.tekst: You have probably noticed it about yourself already. Different years, different people, different work, and somewhere in the middle of it there you are again, doing the thing you always do. That is not a habit you failed to break. That is a pattern, and a pattern is the most honest thing there is to say about a person.

Everything you have read so far is that one pattern, seen from different sides. Your story tells it in events. Your numbers tell it in rhythm. Your planets tell it in character. Your moon phase tells it in timing. Your Tikkun, the one correction you came here to make, tells it in a single sentence. Five languages, one person.
“It is not separate parts. It is one pattern. You.”

items: You cannot stay on the surface for long. You want the version underneath the polite answer, and you will sit there until it comes. Your Sun, your Moon and your Mercury stand together in one sign and one house: what you are, what you feel and how you think all reach for the same depth.
You go first, and then you carry it, and you do not mention that you are carrying it. Your life path 1 asks you to lead. Your Saturn, the planet of duty, asks you to stop doing it alone.

You feel an ending coming before anyone says it out loud. Often you are already halfway out of the room. You were born on a balsamic moon, the last sliver before the dark, so closing is your native language. Your North Node, the direction you grow in, is asking you to build the opening too.
You have held a group together for years and your name is nowhere on it. Your Tikkun and your nodes point at the same move: from carrying everybody to signing your own work.

blokken.tekst:
You are not five separate readings.
You are one pattern, read five ways.

stappen.kaart: How your systems, astrology, numerology and Tikkun, are connected to each other.

blokken.tekst: In the first layer you saw the theme come back. This one is about why it comes back. Not because the systems copy each other, but because they are all looking at the same person and describing her in their own words.

Astrology reads your character: what you are made of, and what drives you automatically from underneath, below the level where you decide things. Those are the voices that talk to you when nobody is watching. Numerology reads your timing: the rhythm you live in, where you are in it right now, and how you could work with that instead of against it. Tikkun reads your correction: the one thing that keeps coming back until you do it differently. All three are saying something about you, each time from a different angle. And where two of them say the same thing, you can stop wondering whether it is true.
“Different lenses. One truth.”

blokken.kop: Five places where two systems say the same thing
items: You are the one people come to. You have been that person so long that it never occurred to you to ask whether it was heavy. Your South Node, the place you come from, sits in the sign of family and belonging, and Saturn, the planet of duty, sits right on top of it. Your Tikkun says it in one line: carrying it alone.

Somewhere there is something you made that has somebody else's name on it, or no name at all. Your North Node, the direction you grow in, and your life path 1 point at the same move: put your own name on your own work, out loud, where people can see it.

You go quiet before you go big, and people read it as hesitation. It is not. Three of your planets stand together in the private room at the back of your chart, and the planet that pushes you out into the world moves slowly and inward first. Everything real happens inside before it comes out. That is not slow. That is your order.

This year has felt more like clearing than building. You were born on a balsamic moon, the closing sliver of the cycle, so endings arrive early for you. And 2026 is a personal 9, the year that finishes things. Your nature and your timing are saying the same word: finish. The 1, the year for putting something where there was nothing, opens in 2027.

You want to be free and you keep signing up for one more responsibility. The number that hums loudest in your name is the 5, freedom. The planet that shaped you is Saturn, duty. That pull is not indecision. It is two real parts of you, both written down.

blokken.kop: Look closer at three of them

items.kort: The oldest agreement you made.
items.tekst: The South Node is where you come from, the place that feels so familiar it does not look like a choice. Yours is in Cancer in house 11: caring for the group, holding the family of people around you together. Saturn sits right on it, and Saturn makes things heavy and serious and yours to carry. So the caring was never soft for you. It came with a bill. And because Saturn is retrograde, the bill was mostly presented by you, to yourself. This is the same pattern your Tikkun names. Three systems, one sentence: you learned to carry the group and to never mention the weight.

items.kort: Why the move takes so long, and why it holds.
items.tekst: Three of your planets stand together in Scorpio in house 4, the private room at the back of the chart. That is where you actually live: deep, unhurried, willing to look at what other people walk around. Opposite it, in house 10 where the world watches, stands Mars in Taurus and it is retrograde. Mars is how you push. In Taurus it pushes slowly, and retrograde it pushes inward before it pushes out. Which means you will almost never be first out loud, and almost always be the one still standing when the fast ones have moved on.

items.titel: The 9 year and the balsamic moon
items.kort: Why this year feels like clearing rather than building.
items.tekst: A balsamic moon is the last sliver before the dark, the end of a cycle. You were born there, which is why endings arrive early for you and why you often leave a room before anyone announces it is over. Add the year you are in: 2026 is a personal 9, the clearing year, the one where things get finished and handed back. Your nature and your timing are pointing the same way right now. If this year has felt like letting go rather than starting, that is not a stall. That is the two of them agreeing.

A shape is easier to live with than a list. You do not have to remember which planet sits where. You only have to remember what you are like, and what keeps asking you to change.
“One page. Your whole picture.”

items: Where you come from: the group, held together by you, and nobody asking whether that was heavy.
What you carry: the habit of taking the weight rather than the risk of asking.
How you are built: deep and private first, visible and slow second, and both are real.
What you are here to build: something with your own name on it, that outlives the moment.
What this year asks: finish, clear, hand back. Not start.
What opens next: a 1 year in 2027, and 1 years are for putting something where there was nothing.

Start here and do nothing else. Read your blueprint in parts, put it away, pick it up again. Give it a few days to settle. What you recognise now will read differently next week.
